source_policy_decisions.decision: The horn dual, a human quality with a bodily qualifier and two proper names are separate inputs. The epic permits the name without making a claim about the founder’s physique.

Keep four prefix words distinct from the supplements with named bases or senses. A two-member animal expression and a place for animals are different constructions even when cattle words occur in the suffixes.
The play has the independently inflected tree name and an independent oil noun. It establishes the material and the verse’s syntax without attesting the frozen single-word iṅgudatailam.
The oil is the grammatical subject, the woman the agent and the mouth the locus. The mother in the next utterance depends on vinā. Preserve both the speaker change and the case owner.
Two independent P3sg/Ā3sg requests. Past narrative with laṭ and sma and augmented passive laṅ are locally resolved on those addresses. No broader grid is credited.
